## TRA Timeline

#### IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-09-13: S-1 files the form-of Income Tax Receivable Agreement as Exhibit 10.3 (85% sharing of cash tax savings from Pre-IPO Tax Assets and imputed interest)
- 2021-09-29: IPO closes; TRA executed between Olaplex Holdings and the Pre-IPO Stockholders (Advent funds via Penelope Group Holdings, plus named individuals); initial $232.9M payable recorded
- 2021-11-10: Q3 2021 10-Q files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2

#### Annual payments

- 2022: $16.5M payment
- 2023: $16.6M payment
- 2024: $12.6M payment
- 2025: $12.1M payment; year-end carrying value $165.1M

#### Henkel merger and TRA termination

- 2026-03-26: Limited Waiver and Amendment executed concurrent with the Henkel merger agreement; inserts new Section 4.01(f) automatically terminating the TRA at the merger Effective Time, with the Advent funds and named individuals (TRA Waiving Parties) irrevocably waiving all remaining payments and a $14,822,247.50 aggregate payment to Non-Waiving TRA Parties at close in lieu of the Section 4.01(d) Change-of-Control formula (Schedule A per-recipient amounts redacted)

## Explanation

Olaplex Holdings, Inc. completed a traditional IPO on September 29, 2021 and executed an Income Tax Receivable Agreement at closing obligating PubCo to pay 85% of cash tax savings on the Pre-IPO Tax Assets (basis step-ups and related attributes from the Pre-IPO Reorganization) plus imputed interest, to the former limited partners of Penelope Group Holdings (principally Advent International funds) and a roster of named individual holders of vested equity awards. The contract paid $57.8M cumulative cash through year-end 2025 against an initial $232.9M payable. In connection with Henkel's announced acquisition, Olaplex and the TRA parties signed a Limited Waiver and Amendment on March 26, 2026 inserting a new Section 4.01(f) automatically terminating the TRA at the merger Effective Time; the Advent funds (majority of TRA economics) waived all remaining payments, and $14.82M aggregate goes to Non-Waiving Parties in lieu of the Section 4.01(d) formula (approximately 9% of the $165.1M carrying value). The termination is contingent on Henkel close; if the merger agreement terminates, the Waiver and Amendment is null and void ab initio and the TRA continues in force. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
